notes: Cryptic Caves (M20). Printed: '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card. Activate only if you control five or more lands.' Seat 0 controls exactly five lands, the Caves among them. The activation is legal (five is enough), the {1} is paid from the pool, the Caves is tapped and sacrificed as the cost, and the draw still happens although only four lands remain when it resolves: hand 1, Caves in the graveyard, the pool empty.
